title: Google introduces "notebooks" in the Gemini app for deeper NotebookLM integration and a space to organize chats and files, after adding sources in December 2025 (Abner Li/9to5Google)
summary: Abner Li / 9to5Google: Google introduces “notebooks” in the Gemini app for deeper NotebookLM integration and a space to organize chats and files, after adding sources in December 2025 — The Gemini app is getting deeper NotebookLM integration after the initial source support introduced last year.
